pageTitle: A Nocturne of the Far North (Event)
name: A Nocturne of the Far North
description: The Wild Hunt vanishes, chaos subsides, and the boughs of the Verdant Crest fill out quietly with life. The Moon-Prayer Night, the night when the moon draws closest to Teyvat, is drawing near. For a land and people long fractured, there is no better balm than a delightful night of celebration. So why don't you and I step out together into this night of joy and laughter, amidst the blooming flowers bathed in the light of the moon?
